title: PJ Harvey · Down by the Water
description: Oxblood velvet hangs over a flooded slate floor. A low red lantern and spreading ripples pick out the singer in the dark.

performance.lyrics: I lost my heart under the bridge to that little girl so much to me and now I'm home and now I holler Ah She'll never know just what I found. That blue eyed girl. Ah She said no more. Ah And that blue eyed girl became blue eyed horse, Ah Ah down by the water I took her hand, Ah just like my daughter We'll see her again Ah Oh, how may Jesus come through the storm? had to lose her, took to her harm. I heard her holler heard her moan, Ah lovely daughter, Ah I took her home, little bish, big bish, maybe in the water, come back here, man, gimme my daughter. little fish, fish, swimming in the water. Come back here, man, give me my daughter. Little fish, big fish, in the water. Come back here, give me my daughter. little fish, big fish, swimming in the water Come back here man, give me Come back here, man, give me my daughter Little fish, big fish, swim in the water man, give me my daughter Little fish, fish, swimmin' in the water Come back here, man, give my daughter
